title: Roughness and entropy measures of a soft set
summary: Soft set theory is an important and emerging area within soft computing, owing to its attribute-oriented mathematical framework and its wide applicability in diverse domains, including science and social sciences. The theoretical constraints associated with the selection of subsets of the sets of attributes in soft set theory have further motivated the development of hybrid and extended theoretical models.
